verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Teams delivers chat-based collaboration, meetings, calling and enterprise voice, so in-app audio and video calling clearly exists. The evidence never shows calls being started directly from a channel or DM. Community reports of in-call bugs (mute and video buttons failing, broken join UI and links) describe reliability problems with calls that do exist, so they weaken quality rather than create a dispute. Missing for 10: documentation of one-click call or video initiation from a channel or DM, explicit audio vs. video options in that flow, and independent hands-on confirmation that it works reliably.
